P.name: Icathian Surprise
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Upon taking {{tip|death|fatal damage}}, '''Kog'Maw''' enters a {{tip|zombie state}} for 4 seconds, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} and gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|10% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that increases up to {{as|50%|MS}} over the duration. At the end of the duration, he explodes to deal {{sti|true damage|{{as|{{pplevel|140 to 650}} true damage}}}} to nearby enemies.
P.description2: While under this state, '''Kog'Maw''' becomes {{tip|invulnerability|invulnerable}}, {{tip|untargetable}}, and {{tip|cc-immune|immune to crowd control}}, but is also rendered unable to declare {{tip|basic attacks}}, cast {{tip|abilities}}, use [[summoner spell]]s, and [[active ability items|activate items]].

Q.name: Caustic Spittle
Q.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kog'Maw''' ejects a wad of spittle in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and reduces their {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|magic resistance}}}} for 4 seconds.

W.name: Bio-Arcane Barrage
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kog'Maw''' empowers his [[basic attack]]s for the next 8 seconds to gain {{sti|range|'''bonus''' attack range}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}, capped at 100 against {{tip|minion|minions}} and {{tip|monster|monsters}}.
W.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Attack Range|{{ap|130 to 210}}}}
{{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|3 to 6}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|1.5}}% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health}}}}

E.name: Void Ooze
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kog'Maw''' spews a gob of ooze in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
E.description2: A field of ooze is created in its wake for 3 seconds, {{tip|slow|slowing}} enemies within the area every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.

R.name: Living Artillery
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kog'Maw''' spits a globule of acid into the air that drops to the target location after {{fd|0.6}} seconds, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area before dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for 2 seconds. ''Living Artillery's'' damage is increased by {{as|{{pp|type=target's '''missing''' health|key=%|0 to 50 for 11|key1=%|0 to 60|formula=0.833% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health. ''This is capped at 50% increase at 60% '''missing''' health.''}}|health}}, or instead by {{ccs|100%|magic}} if the target is below {{as|40% '''maximum''' health}}.
R.leveling: {{st|Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|100 to 180}} {{as|(+ 75% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|35 to 45}}% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|100*2 to 180*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|75*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|35*2 to 45*2}}% AP)}}}}
R.description2: '''Kog'Maw''' then generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Living Artillery'' for 8 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts and stacking up to 9 times.
R.description3: {{sbc|Living Artillery:}} For each stack, ''Living Artillery's'' {{sti|{{as|mana cost}}}} is increased by {{as|40|mana}}.
